# TPC-DS-OBT Q93

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  ship_customer_sk,
  SUM(act_sales) AS sumsales
FROM (
  SELECT
    obt.item_sk,
    obt.sale_id,
    obt.ship_customer_sk,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT obt.return_quantity IS NULL
      THEN (
        obt.quantity - obt.return_quantity
      ) * obt.sales_price
      ELSE (
        obt.quantity * obt.sales_price
      )
    END AS act_sales
  FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
  WHERE
    (
      (
        obt.reason_sk = obt.reason_r_reason_sk AND obt.reason_r_reason_desc = '0'
      )
      AND (
        obt.item_sk = obt.item_sk AND obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id
      )
    )
    AND channel = 'store'
) AS t
GROUP BY
  ship_customer_sk
ORDER BY
  sumsales,
  ship_customer_sk
LIMIT 100
```
